decisive_items: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion of mostly fat density
response.rationale: R1 is the champion because the patient's imaging studies show a large, fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland, which is consistent with adrenal myelolipoma. R4 is the runner-up because the presence of a large, complex mass with both fatty and soft-tissue components is consistent with teratoma, but the location and characteristics of the mass are more consistent with adrenal myelolipoma.

rejected.why: Lipoma is less likely because the mass has internal areas of soft-tissue density and is located in the retroperitoneal space, which is not typical for lipoma.
